_meta.strategy: Same message body, submitted across the category spectrum so Meta reveals where 'utility' stops and 'marketing' begins. {{1}}=patient name, {{2}}=abnormal panel list (from abnormal-panel-recall.sql).

templates._label: 1. SAFE UTILITY — pure follow-up, no offer (expected: APPROVED, UTILITY)
templates.name: abnormal_result_followup

components.text: Hi {{1}}, this is a health follow-up from Sobhana Diagnostics. Some of your recent results ({{2}}) were outside the normal range, and a repeat test is recommended to keep track. Reply here or call us to book a convenient time.

body_text: Complete Blood Picture, Liver Function Test

templates._label: 2. UTILITY + soft concession, no number (expected: UTILITY or recat MARKETING)
templates.name: abnormal_recheck_courtesy

components.text: Hi {{1}}, following up on your recent report from Sobhana Diagnostics. Your {{2}} results were outside the normal range and a repeat test is advised. As a returning patient, a concessional rate applies on your follow-up test. Reply to book.

templates._label: 3. UTILITY submit, explicit 50% (expected: likely RECAT to MARKETING)
templates.name: abnormal_recheck_halfoff

components.text: Hi {{1}}, a follow-up from Sobhana Diagnostics: your {{2}} results were outside the normal range and a repeat test is advised. To make re-checking easier, your follow-up test is available at 50% off this month. Reply or call to book.

templates._label: 4. HONEST MARKETING — 50%, vague health ref, opt-out (expected: APPROVED, MARKETING)
templates.name: health_recheck_offer

components.text: Hi {{1}}, staying on top of your health is easier with the right check-up. Some of your recent Sobhana Diagnostics results were outside the normal range. Re-check now at 50% off, valid this month. Reply BOOK and we will arrange a convenient time.

templates._label: 5. MARKETING — 50% + named panel (expected: APPROVED, MARKETING; panel-in-marketing is the risk)
templates.name: abnormal_recheck_offer_specific
